About AGROSAF PHARMACEUTICALS PRIVATE LIMITED

Agrosaf Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.
Agrosaf Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is a fast-growing pharmaceutical company based in Agra,
Uttar Pradesh, India, committed to delivering high-quality, affordable, and reliable healthcare
solutions across the country.
Founded with a vision to make quality medicines accessible to all, Agrosaf has rapidly
expanded its product portfolio to 1700+ pharmaceutical products, covering a wide range of
therapeutic segments. Our offerings include tablets, capsules, syrups, suspensions,
ointments, creams, injections, IV fluids, nasal sprays, rotocaps, OTC products, Ayurvedic
formulations, nutraceuticals, and wellness products.
We collaborate with WHO-GMP certified manufacturers and follow stringent quality control
processes to ensure safety, efficacy, and consistency in every product. Today, Agrosaf proudly
serves 20,000+ active customers across 28 states and 750+ districts in India, supported by
a strong distribution and supply chain network.
Agrosaf Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. also specializes in third-party manufacturing, private
labeling, and franchise opportunities, offering end-to-end support including product selection,
branding, packaging, regulatory assistance, and marketing guidance.
Driven by innovation, transparency, and a customer-first approach, Agrosaf continues to set new
benchmarks in pharmaceutical excellence while building long-term partnerships with
distributors, hospitals, pharmacies, and healthcare professionals.
Agrosaf – Delivering Trust, Quality & Care.
